answer: To resist sybils, agents must build a sequential reputation ledge: each identity posts an increasing bond to bridge to the next attestation epoch, with the required stake sized to the square of any funding-cluster size detected in the prior window. The bond is fully slashed and the entire ledge collapses if a randomized live probe fails on any cluster member, so the capital at risk for the (n+1)th clone rises quadratically while the attacker cannot pre-age or parallelize the sequential anchor history that unlocks higher tiers.
